name: Bangsaen21
short_description: Bangsaen21 is a half-marathon (21.1 km) held at Bang Saen Beach in Bangsaen, Chonburi, Thailand on December 20, 2026.
ai_summary: Bangsaen21 is a half marathon scheduled for Sunday 20 December 2026, starting and finishing in front of the Bangsaen Heritage Hotel at Bang Saen Beach in Chonburi, Thailand. It is a single-distance race over 21.0975 km, organised by MICE and Communication Co., Ltd., which also stages Bangsaen42. The 2026 race carries a World Athletics Platinum Label.

core_facts.venue: Bang Saen Beach, in front of the Bangsaen Heritage Hotel

pros: Flat out-and-back course on fully closed roads
Drier December air: a dew point of about 18°C at the 2025 start
Deep field: the 100th man ran 1:21:27 and the 100th woman 1:42:40 in 2025
Water about every 2 km, most stations passed twice
World Athletics Platinum Label race with prize money and Sammy and Mukkie trophies
cons: Three-and-a-half-hour limit, with cut-offs at 10, 15 and 20 km in 2026
Waves start from 4.15am in 2026 and the start line closes at 5am
Most Thai places are drawn by ballot (4,000 in the 2025 general round)
Face ID check at pickup and no bib transfers

faqs.question: When is Bangsaen21 taking place?
faqs.answer: Bangsaen21 is on Sunday 20 December 2026. It starts and finishes in front of the Bangsaen Heritage Hotel at Bang Saen Beach, Chonburi, with waves at 4.15am, 4.30am and 4.45am. Bib pickup is in person at the Heritage Convention Center on 18 and 19 December, and runners must be 19 or older.

faqs.question: What distance is Bangsaen21?
faqs.answer: Bangsaen21 is a half marathon only, over the official distance of 21.0975 km. The course is an out-and-back from Bang Saen to a U-turn at about 10.3 km on Route 3134, returning along the road around Khao Sam Muk. The time limit is 3 hours 30 minutes, with cut-offs at 10, 15 and 20 km.

faqs.question: Where is Bangsaen21 held?
faqs.answer: The race is held on the beach road at Bang Saen, Chonburi, with the start and finish in front of the Bangsaen Heritage Hotel. The organiser is MICE and Communication Co., Ltd., which also runs the Bangsaen42 marathon in November. Saen Suk's mayor said the roads would be fully closed for the 2025 race.
